title: Heartbleed vulnerability (CVE-2014-0160) in your library
description: Your project is affected by the Heartbleed vulnerability, CVE-2014-0160. An attacker can exploit the TLS heartbeat extension to read sensitive memory from the server, including private keys and passwords. This is a critical issue affecting all versions. Please upgrade OpenSSL to 1.0.1g or later.
poc_text: Send a malformed TLS heartbeat request to leak process memory.
